name: @nightcast/contract
description: Nightcast: verifiable randomness for Midnight. The Compact contract (compiled, with proving keys), key helpers and an in-memory simulator. Experimental and unaudited: testnets only.
author: LearnMidnight

scripts.compact: compact compile src/nightcast.compact src/managed/nightcast && npm run compact:words
scripts.compact:fast: compact compile --skip-zk src/nightcast.compact src/managed/nightcast && npm run compact:words
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/managed dist/managed && cp src/nightcast.compact src/NightcastWords.compact dist/
scripts.compact:words: compact compile --skip-zk src/words.compact src/managed/words && compact compile --skip-zk src/test/words-probe.compact src/test/managed/words-probe
